correctness.rationale: A fixed set of 2-labeled core vertices induces exactly three independently checked local fibers A, B, C. All zero-label conditions are necessary and sufficient. The cyclic four-state matrix correctly reconstructs all labeled masks and has determinant 1-(A+C)u-Azu^2-ABzu^3; formal trace-log identity gives the generating function. Minimum weight equals n+gamma(C_n) from the weighted subset formula and the known cycle domination bound. The cyclic gaps of selected 2-vertices exhaust equality possibilities, with the extra factor 2 for each uncovered core vertex. The package path verify.py was executed successfully and compares all 597780 ternary assignments in orders 3..6, subset enumeration through 12, and traces/recurrence/minimum multiplicities through 14. Infinite claims rest on the symbolic proof, not these finite tests.

value.rationale: Sunlet graphs form a standard sparse corona family and Roman domination models weighted guard distributions. The old minimum weight fixes only one exponent and cannot provide the complete coefficient profile. The derived cubic denominator, positive recurrence, local classification and sharply residue-dependent counts of optimal Roman assignments refine a natural open enumerative profile rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. They are potentially reusable for comparing graph transformations and understanding minimum-solution degeneracy; no downstream unproved theorem is asserted.
